pages.title: A tool of the boundary
pages.text: “A scythe is more than a weapon. It marks the limit of every life. But who says that limit cannot be used to your advantage?”$(br2)The Scythe of the Beyond turns damage dealt into recovery. Each successful hit restores 20–30% of the damage as health and half a hunger point.$(br2)The dead cannot wield the scythe: it cannot be held in $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l), and undead creatures do not provide ordinary loot.

pages.title: Stored souls
pages.text: When you kill a creature with the Scythe of the Beyond, its soul does not drop normally; instead, the scythe gains 5 charge. With at least one charge, right-click to freeze mobs within $(thing)10 blocks$() and gain Strength V. At full charge, Reaping activates and every hit becomes lethal.

pages.title: Scythe in the vault
pages.text: A Scythe in the main hand cell of the $(l:beginning/vault)Vault$(/l) charges too, from any kill. While its $(thing)power is on$(), souls never appear, even at full charge. To get souls, turn the Scythe's power off. To activate it, hold right click with an empty hand for 3 seconds.
